title: Tweety
blurb: A small yellow canary whose wide-eyed innocent act routinely outmaneuvers Sylvester the cat, one of Warner Bros.' most enduring stars.
facts: His characteristics are based on Red Skelton's famous "Junior the Mean Widdle Kid".
He appeared in 46 cartoons during the golden age, made between 1942 and 1964.
